{{Top|leg}}
'''Fanrill''' was a [[General/Legends|general]] in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] during the [[Galactic War]].

==Behind the scenes==
If Republic players choose to forcibly conscript the refugees from [[Makeb]], they will receive a message from General Fanrill rather than one from [[Shalim Avesta]].
